name: Image Utility
description: Free, 100% private client-side in-browser image editing tools. Resize, compress, crop, convert formats, add borders, round corners, and scrub metadata with zero server uploads.

capabilities.name: resize
capabilities.description: Resize image dimensions with aspect ratio lock or custom dimensions.

capabilities.name: compress
capabilities.description: Compress image to target file size in KB or custom quality slider.

capabilities.name: convert
capabilities.description: Convert image between PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, BMP, and ICO.

capabilities.name: crop
capabilities.description: Crop image with 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or custom freeform crop presets.

capabilities.name: circle
capabilities.description: Circle crop image to create rounded avatars with transparent PNG.

capabilities.name: radius
capabilities.description: Round image corners with transparent outer border clipping.

capabilities.name: border
capabilities.description: Add customizable border frame and padding to image.

capabilities.name: rotate
capabilities.description: Rotate 90, 180, 270 degrees or flip horizontally and vertically.

capabilities.name: favicon
capabilities.description: Generate multi-resolution ICO, Apple Touch icon, and PWA icons.

capabilities.name: watermark
capabilities.description: Add customizable text watermarks with opacity and positioning.

capabilities.name: pdf
capabilities.description: Convert image to single-page A4, Letter, or fit printable PDF.

capabilities.name: metadata
capabilities.description: Scrub EXIF tags, GPS location coordinates, and camera serial metadata.
